name: Limited Words
desc:
Welcome to Limited Words! In this game, you'll spawn with a random number of words that you can use to communicate with other players.

This game is a type of simulator that you can talk and hangout in with friends or even roleplay!

Your progress is saved automatically, so you can pick up where you left off each time you play.

We often release free limited UGC, that people can claim while hanging out or chilling! 

Work together and get the most words while talking with friends and having fun!
